# Death Stare — curated vanilla interaction LIOS (auto_accept OR + ai_accept safety)
# Footprint: full object redefine of listed keys only. Last loaded wins.
# Do not edit Supreme Sovereign / Exalted suite.
# LIOS: demand_conversion_interaction — Death Stare auto_accept OR + ai_accept safety

demand_conversion_interaction = {
	icon = religious
	category = interaction_category_religion
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	can_send_despite_rejection = yes
	ai_maybe = yes

	notification_text = HOUSE_HEAD_DEMAND_CONVERSION

	is_shown = {
		scope:puppet_or_actor ?= {
			this != scope:recipient
			is_house_head = yes
			faith != scope:recipient.faith
			OR = {
				house ?= scope:recipient.house
				AND = { # House Bloc
					house.house_confederation ?= {
						scope:recipient.house.house_confederation ?= this
						has_cohesion_level_parameter = bloc_members_join_leaders_faith
					}
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			scope:recipient = { # Use the vassal-liege interaction instead.
				is_ruler = yes
				target_is_liege_or_above = scope:puppet_or_actor
			}
		}
		scope:recipient = { # To avoid you converting someone's entire family, and then asking them. Restricting it to landed rulers at least gives them a chance to create their own cadet house.
			is_ruler = yes
		}
	}

	cooldown_against_recipient = { years = 15 }

	desc = {
		desc = demand_conversion_interaction_desc
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				scope:puppet_or_actor = {
					refusing_conversion_is_crime_trigger = {
						CHARACTER = scope:recipient
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					target_is_liege_or_above = scope:puppet_or_actor
				}
			}
			desc = demand_conversion_vassal_ruler_is_crime
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		valid_demand_conversion_conditions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { scope:is_puppet_action ?= yes }
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				influence >= demand_conversion_influence_cost_value
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		influence = {
			value = demand_conversion_influence_cost_value
			if = {
				limit = { scope:is_puppet_action ?= yes }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:is_puppet_action ?= yes }
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { demand_conversion_influence_cost_value > 0 }
					change_influence = {
						value = {
							value = demand_conversion_influence_cost_value
							max = influence
							multiply = -1
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		demand_conversion_interaction_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { scope:hook = yes }
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				use_hook = scope:recipient
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				save_scope_value_as = {
					name = forcibly_converted
					value = yes
				}
			}
		}
		scope:puppet_or_actor = {
			trigger_event = char_interaction.0181
		}

		scope:puppet_or_actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_character_struggle = {
						involvement = involved
						has_struggle_phase_parameter = piety_from_converting_involved_rulers
						is_secondary_character_involvement_involved_trigger = {
							CHAR = scope:recipient
						}
					}
				}
				add_piety = medium_piety_gain
			}
		}

		# If we're a clan this interaction affects unity
		accept_faith_conversion_add_clan_unity_effect = yes

		# If character is converting to the state faith, we add influence
		state_faith_conversion_add_piety_effect = yes

		conversion_tenet_acts_of_the_apostles_effect = yes

		# If you have the Mendicant Preaching personal tenet we give you SP
		conversion_tenet_mendicant_preachers_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:recipient = {
			execute_decision = create_cadet_branch_decision
			show_as_tooltip = { create_cadet_branch = {} }
		}
		#Negative opinions
		scope:recipient = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:puppet_or_actor = {
						refusing_conversion_is_crime_trigger = {
							CHARACTER = scope:recipient
						}
					}
					scope:recipient = {
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:puppet_or_actor
					}
				}
				reverse_add_opinion = {
					target = scope:puppet_or_actor
					modifier = illegal_resisted_conversion_opinion
					years = 10
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_opinion = {
					modifier = demanded_my_conversion_opinion
					target = scope:puppet_or_actor
					opinion = -10
				}
			}
		}
		scope:puppet_or_actor = {
			trigger_event = char_interaction.0182
		}

		# If we're a clan this interaction affects unity
		refuse_faith_conversion_add_clan_unity_effect = yes

		state_faith_refuse_conversion_add_piety_effect = yes
	}

	auto_accept = {
		OR = {
			custom_description = {
				text = ds_cowed_auto_accept_reason
				subject = scope:actor
				object = scope:recipient
				ds_cowed_auto_accept_trigger = yes
			}
			custom_description = {
				text = "spending_hook"
				subject = scope:puppet_or_actor
				object = scope:recipient
				scope:hook = yes
				scope:puppet_or_actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
			}
		}
	}

	#For loc
	on_auto_accept = {
		scope:recipient = {
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = forcibly_converted
				value = yes
			}
		}
	}

	ai_accept = {
		# Death Stare safety net
		ds_cowed_ai_accept_modifier = yes
		base = 0

		celestial_hierarchy_acceptance_modifier = {
			ACTOR = scope:puppet_or_actor
			RECIPIENT = scope:recipient
		}

		# Increase base chance
		modifier = {
			add = 50
			desc = EDUCATE_CHILD_ACTOR_IS_MY_LIEGE
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 100
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = {
					can_execute_decision = create_cadet_branch_decision
				}
			}
			desc = ASK_FOR_CONVERSION_CAN_NOT_CREATE_CADET_BRANCH
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -10
			scope:recipient = {
				can_execute_decision = create_cadet_branch_decision
			}
			desc = ASK_FOR_CONVERSION_CAN_CREATE_CADET_BRANCH
		}
		religion_demand_conversion_default_modifier = yes
		religion_demand_conversion_christian_situation_modifier = yes
	}

	can_send_despite_rejection = yes
	force_notification = yes

	#Use hook
	send_option = {
		is_valid = {
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				has_usable_hook = scope:recipient
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:puppet_or_actor }
			}
		}
		flag = hook
		localization = SCHEME_HOOK
	}
	should_use_extra_icon = {
		scope:puppet_or_actor = { has_usable_hook = scope:recipient }
	}
	extra_icon = "gfx/interface/icons/character_interactions/hook_icon.dds"

	send_option = { # EP3 Influence
		is_shown = { # Actor must have a government that uses influence
			scope:puppet_or_actor ?= {
				government_has_flag = government_has_influence
			}
		}
		is_valid = {
			# Actor has enough influence
			scope:puppet_or_actor = { influence >= medium_influence_value }
			# Both characters are within the same top realm
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = not_same_realm_tt
				scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:puppet_or_actor.top_liege
			}
		}
		flag = influence_send_option
		localization = TRADE_INFLUENCE_FOR_BETTER_AI_ACCEPTANCE
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no
}



# LIOS: demand_conversion_vassal_ruler_interaction — Death Stare auto_accept OR + ai_accept safety

demand_conversion_vassal_ruler_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	icon = religious
	notification_text = LIEGE_DEMAND_CONVERSION

	ai_maybe = yes
	ai_min_reply_days = 4
	ai_max_reply_days = 9
	can_send_despite_rejection = yes
	ai_accept_negotiation = yes
	popup_on_receive = yes

	ai_targets = {
		ai_recipients = vassals
	}
	ai_target_quick_trigger = {
		adult = yes
	}
	ai_frequency_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 120
		duchy = 24
		kingdom = 12
		empire = 12
		hegemony = 12
	}

	desc = {
		desc = ask_for_conversion_interaction_desc
		desc = line_break
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:puppet_or_actor } }
			}
			desc = might_ask_for_something_in_return_warning
		}
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				scope:puppet_or_actor = {
					refusing_conversion_is_crime_trigger = {
						CHARACTER = scope:recipient
					}
				}
			}
			desc = demand_conversion_vassal_ruler_is_crime
		}
	}

	on_decline_summary = stop_attacker_vassal_war_decline_summary

	is_available = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			is_adult = yes
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		scope:puppet_or_actor ?= {
			NOT = { faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				target_is_liege_or_above = scope:puppet_or_actor
				is_tributary_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
			}
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
		}
	}

	cooldown_against_recipient = { years = 15 }

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		valid_demand_conversion_conditions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { scope:is_puppet_action ?= yes }
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				influence >= demand_conversion_influence_cost_value
			}
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:puppet_or_actor.domicile ?= {
					domicile_uses_culture_and_faith = yes
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					is_ruler = yes
					government_has_flag = government_is_in_steppe
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = nomads_must_inspire_tt
				always = no
			}
		}
	}

	auto_accept = {
		OR = {
			custom_description = {
				text = ds_cowed_auto_accept_reason
				subject = scope:actor
				object = scope:recipient
				ds_cowed_auto_accept_trigger = yes
			}
			custom_description = {
				text = "spending_hook"
				subject = scope:puppet_or_actor
				object = scope:recipient
				scope:hook = yes
				scope:puppet_or_actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { scope:recipient = { has_character_flag = ai_will_not_convert } }
			}
		}
	}

	on_send = {
		pam_tax_nonbelievers_conversion_concession_effect = yes
	}

	cost = {
		influence = {
			value = demand_conversion_influence_cost_value
			if = {
				limit = { scope:is_puppet_action ?= yes }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:is_puppet_action ?= yes }
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { demand_conversion_influence_cost_value > 0 }
					change_influence = {
						value = {
							value = demand_conversion_influence_cost_value
							max = influence
							multiply = -1
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:puppet_or_actor = {
			trigger_event = religious_interaction.2002
		}
		demand_conversion_vassal_ruler_interaction_effect = yes

		# If we're a clan this interaction affects unity
		accept_faith_conversion_add_clan_unity_effect = yes

		# If character is converting to the state faith, we add influence
		state_faith_conversion_add_piety_effect = yes

		scope:puppet_or_actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_character_struggle = {
						involvement = involved
						has_struggle_phase_parameter = piety_from_converting_involved_rulers
						is_secondary_character_involvement_involved_trigger = {
							CHAR = scope:recipient
						}
					}
				}
				add_piety = medium_piety_gain
			}
		}

		conversion_tenet_acts_of_the_apostles_effect = yes

		# If you have the Mendicant Preaching personal tenet we give you SP
		conversion_tenet_mendicant_preachers_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:recipient = {
			hidden_effect = {
				random_list = {
					80 = { # Conditional acceptance
						modifier = {
							factor = 0 # Heresiarchs never agree to convert
							scope:recipient = {
								has_trait = heresiarch
							}
						}
						ai_value_modifier = {
							ai_greed = 0.5
						}
						random_list = {
							10 = { #They ask for gold
								modifier = {
									add = 50 # More likely to ask for gold if they're poor
									scope:recipient.short_term_gold < medium_gold_value
								}
								modifier = {
									add = { # Much more likely to ask for gold involved in one of their own wars (they want to win).
										value = 50
										if = {
											# Especially true if they're in debt!
											limit = { gold < 0 }
											add = 150
										}
									}
									is_at_war = yes
									any_character_war = {
										is_war_leader = scope:recipient
									}
								}
								scope:puppet_or_actor = {
									trigger_event = {
										id = religious_interaction.2011
									}
								}
							}
							50 = { #They ask for a favor
								trigger = {
									exists = scope:recipient.capital_county
									NOT = { has_hook = scope:puppet_or_actor }
								}
								# Direct feudal vassals appreciate favors more (they can improve their contract).
								modifier = {
									add = {
										value = 50
										# This goes double for your Powerful Vassals. A better contract is likely to be much more important than a short-term payout.
										if = {
											limit = { is_powerful_vassal_of = scope:puppet_or_actor }
											add = 100
										}
									}
									this.liege = scope:puppet_or_actor
									government_has_flag = government_is_feudal
								}
								scope:puppet_or_actor = {
									trigger_event = {
										id = religious_interaction.2012
									}
								}
							}
							40 = { # They ask to study the faith first
							    trigger = {
							        # Must not already know the faith well
							        knows_rite_level = {
							            target = scope:puppet_or_actor.rite
							            value < 0.9
							        }
							        can_start_scheme = {
							            type = study_faith
							            target_character = scope:puppet_or_actor
							        }
							    }
							    # Higher weight if they would suffer severe penalties
							    modifier = {
							        add = 300
							        knows_rite_level = {
							            target = scope:puppet_or_actor.rite
							            value < 0.7
							        }
							    }
							    # Scholarly/theologian types prefer this
							    modifier = {
							        add = 10
							        has_trait = erudite
							    }
							    modifier = {
							        add = 10
							        has_trait = theologian
							    }
							    modifier = {
							        add = 10
							        OR = {
							        	has_trait = education_learning_3
							        	has_trait = education_learning_4
							        	has_trait = education_learning_5
							        }
							    }
							    modifier = {
							        add = 10
							        learning >= 12
							    }
							    scope:puppet_or_actor = {
							        trigger_event = {
							            id = religious_interaction.2015
							        }
							    }
							}
						}

					}
					20 = { # Full refuse
						modifier = {
							add = 20
							scope:recipient.demand_conversion_likelihood_calculation < 40
						}
						modifier = {
							add = 20
							scope:recipient.demand_conversion_likelihood_calculation < 20
						}
						modifier = {
							add = 50
							scope:recipient.demand_conversion_likelihood_calculation < 0
						}
						scope:puppet_or_actor = {
							trigger_event = {
								id = religious_interaction.2003
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = demand_conversion_vassal_ruler_does_not_convert
			show_as_tooltip = {
				#Negative opinions
				add_opinion = {
					modifier = demanded_my_conversion_opinion
					target = scope:puppet_or_actor
					opinion = -10
				}
				scope:puppet_or_actor = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							refusing_conversion_is_crime_trigger = {
								CHARACTER = scope:recipient
							}
						}
						custom_tooltip = action_can_lawfully_imprison_label
					}
				}
				# If appropriate, give 'em piety.
				give_piety_for_clinging_to_state_faith_effect = yes
			}
		}

		# If we're a clan this interaction affects unity
		refuse_faith_conversion_add_clan_unity_effect = yes
	}

	# Use hook
	send_option = {
		is_valid = {
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				has_usable_hook = scope:recipient
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:puppet_or_actor }
			}
		}
		flag = hook
		localization = SCHEME_HOOK
	}
	should_use_extra_icon = {
		scope:puppet_or_actor = { has_usable_hook = scope:recipient }
	}
	extra_icon = "gfx/interface/icons/character_interactions/hook_icon.dds"

	send_option = { # EP3 Influence
		is_shown = { # Actor must have a government that uses influence
			scope:puppet_or_actor ?= {
				government_has_flag = government_has_influence
			}
		}
		is_valid = {
			# Actor has enough influence
			scope:puppet_or_actor = { influence >= medium_influence_value }
			# Both characters are within the same top realm
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = not_same_realm_tt
				scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:puppet_or_actor.top_liege
			}
		}
		flag = influence_send_option
		localization = TRADE_INFLUENCE_FOR_BETTER_AI_ACCEPTANCE
	}

	send_option = {
		is_shown = {
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				has_personal_tenet_flag = tax_nonbelievers_conversion_concession
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				is_vassal_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
			}
		}
		is_valid = {
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				gold >= medium_gold_value
			}
		}
		starts_enabled = {
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				scope:actor = { is_ai = yes }
				short_term_gold >= medium_gold_value
			}
			scope:recipient.demand_conversion_likelihood_calculation < 70
		}
		flag = tax_nonbelievers_conversion_concession
		localization = pam_tax_nonbelievers_conversion_concession_option
		current_description = pam_tax_nonbelievers_conversion_concession_option_desc
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100

		modifier = { # Make sure the AI uses hooks for this as it's % based
			scope:hook = yes
			add = 1
		}
		modifier = {
			scope:tax_nonbelievers_conversion_concession = yes
			scope:recipient.demand_conversion_likelihood_calculation < 70
			add = 1
		}

		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			scope:recipient.demand_conversion_likelihood_calculation < 10
			NOT = {
				scope:puppet_or_actor = {
					refusing_conversion_is_crime_trigger = {
						CHARACTER = scope:recipient
					}
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			scope:recipient.demand_conversion_likelihood_calculation < 70
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				gold < demand_conversion_bribe_size
			}
		}

		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			scope:recipient.demand_conversion_likelihood_calculation < 90
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = less_likely_to_force_conversion
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Do not convert Righteous faith subjects, unless disturbingly zealous
			factor = 0
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				ai_zeal < 100
				rite = {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_fully_accepted_level
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = { # If the subject has one of your holy sites, always try to convert
				scope:puppet_or_actor.faith = {
					any_holy_site = {
						holy_site_county ?= {
							holder ?= {
								OR = {
									this = scope:recipient
									is_vassal_or_below_of = scope:recipient
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Astray faiths require specific circumstances to demand conversion of
			factor = 0
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				has_tolerant_faith_or_culture_trigger = yes
				ai_zeal < 100
				rite = {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_astray_level
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = { # If the subject has one of your holy sites, always try to convert
				scope:puppet_or_actor.faith = {
					any_holy_site = {
						holy_site_county ?= {
							holder ?= {
								OR = {
									this = scope:recipient
									is_vassal_or_below_of = scope:recipient
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Astray faiths require specific circumstances to demand conversion of
			factor = 0
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_pluralism_fundamentalist }
				ai_zeal < -10
				rite = {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_astray_level
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = { # If the subject has one of your holy sites, always try to convert
				scope:puppet_or_actor.faith = {
					any_holy_site = {
						holy_site_county ?= {
							holder ?= {
								OR = {
									this = scope:recipient
									is_vassal_or_below_of = scope:recipient
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Astray faiths require specific circumstances to demand conversion of
			factor = 0
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				NOR = {
					rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_pluralism_fundamentalist }
					has_tolerant_faith_or_culture_trigger = yes
				}
				ai_zeal < 25
				rite = {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_astray_level
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = { # If the subject has one of your holy sites, always try to convert
				scope:puppet_or_actor.faith = {
					any_holy_site = {
						holy_site_county ?= {
							holder ?= {
								OR = {
									this = scope:recipient
									is_vassal_or_below_of = scope:recipient
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Rulers with state faith won't try to convert people with rites that are astray or better
			factor = 0
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				government_allows = state_faith
				primary_title.state_rite ?= {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_astray_level
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_accept = {
		# Death Stare safety net
		ds_cowed_ai_accept_modifier = yes
		base = 0

		celestial_hierarchy_acceptance_modifier = {
			ACTOR = scope:puppet_or_actor
			RECIPIENT = scope:recipient
		}

		# Increase base chance
		modifier = {
			add = 50
			desc = EDUCATE_CHILD_ACTOR_IS_MY_LIEGE
		}
		religion_demand_conversion_default_modifier = yes
		religion_demand_conversion_christian_situation_modifier = yes

		modifier = {
			desc = might_ask_for_something_in_return_warning_line_break
			add = 0
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 25
			scope:tax_nonbelievers_conversion_concession = yes
			desc = pam_tax_nonbelievers_conversion_acceptance_reason
		}
	}
}



# LIOS: ask_for_conversion_interaction — Death Stare auto_accept OR + ai_accept safety

ask_for_conversion_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	special_interaction = request_conversion_interaction
	popup_on_receive = yes

	desc = compel_conversion_interaction_desc

	hidden = yes

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor.faith != scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient.liege ?= scope:actor
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		valid_ask_for_conversion_conditions_trigger = yes
	}

	ai_accept = {
		# Death Stare safety net
		ds_cowed_ai_accept_modifier = yes
		base = 0

		celestial_hierarchy_acceptance_modifier = {
			ACTOR = scope:actor
			RECIPIENT = scope:recipient
		}

		religion_demand_conversion_default_modifier = yes
		religion_demand_conversion_christian_situation_modifier = yes

		# We add a few extra modifiers if you have a state faith, to make the initial conversion rate more immersive and plausible
		modifier = {
			scope:actor = {
				government_allows = state_faith

				# If you fulfill a minimum amount of the below triggers, we consider that you hold enough sway within the realm to make it easier for others to abandon the state faith
				calc_true_if = {
					amount >= 4

					diplomacy >= excellent_skill_level
					learning >= excellent_skill_level
					has_trait = august # You finished the August lifestyle tree
					has_trait = theologian # You finished the Theologian lifestyle tree
					AND = {
						top_liege = this
						legitimacy_level >= 4
					}
					influence_level >= 3
					house = {
						OR = {
							is_dominant_family = yes
							is_powerful_family = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:actor.influence_level = 5
					}
					add = 50
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						scope:actor.influence_level >= 4
					}
					add = 25
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:actor = {
							top_liege = this
							legitimacy_level >= 5
						}
					}
					add = 50
				}
			}
			desc = STATE_FAITH_CREATE_FAITH_REASON
		}
		modifier = { # If you have the prophet perk, let's increase acceptance equal to half your diplomacy and learning
			scope:actor = {
				government_allows = state_faith
				has_perk = prophet_perk
			}
			add = {
				value = scope:actor.learning
				add = scope:actor.diplomacy
				multiply = 0.5
			}
			desc = HAS_PERK_PROPHET_REASON
		}

	}

	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 5

	on_accept = {
		new_faith_created_conversion_effect = yes

		# If we're a clan this interaction affects unity
		accept_faith_conversion_add_clan_unity_effect = yes

		# If character is converting to the state faith, we add influence
		state_faith_conversion_add_piety_effect = yes

		# Piety gain from Struggle Phase
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_character_struggle = {
						involvement = involved
						has_struggle_phase_parameter = piety_from_converting_involved_rulers
						is_secondary_character_involvement_involved_trigger = {
							CHAR = scope:recipient
						}
					}
				}
				add_piety = medium_piety_gain
			}
		}

		conversion_tenet_acts_of_the_apostles_effect = yes

		# If you have the Mendicant Preaching personal tenet we give you SP
		conversion_tenet_mendicant_preachers_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_bad
				title = ask_for_conversion_decline_notification
				right_icon = scope:recipient
			}
		}

		# If we're a clan this interaction affects unity
		refuse_faith_conversion_add_clan_unity_effect = yes

		state_faith_refuse_conversion_add_piety_effect = yes
	}

	#Use hook
	send_option = {
		is_valid = {
			always = no # Only here to ensure that religion_demand_conversion_default_modifier doesn't error
		}
		flag = hook
		localization = SCHEME_HOOK
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no

	# Death Stare: directed Yes Man auto-accept
	auto_accept = {
		OR = {
			custom_description = {
				text = ds_cowed_auto_accept_reason
				subject = scope:actor
				object = scope:recipient
				ds_cowed_auto_accept_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
}



# LIOS: ask_for_conversion_courtier_interaction — Death Stare auto_accept OR + ai_accept safety

ask_for_conversion_courtier_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	icon = religious

	special_interaction = request_conversion_interaction
	ai_maybe = yes
	can_send_despite_rejection = yes

	desc = {
		desc = ask_for_conversion_interaction_desc
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				scope:actor = {
					refusing_conversion_is_crime_trigger = {
						CHARACTER = scope:recipient
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					target_is_liege_or_above = scope:actor
				}
			}
			desc = demand_conversion_vassal_ruler_is_crime
		}
	}

	ai_targets = {
		ai_recipients = courtiers
		chance = 0.25
	}
	ai_target_quick_trigger = {
		adult = yes
	}
	ai_frequency_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 36
		duchy = 12
		kingdom = 12
		empire = 12
		hegemony = 12
	}

	is_available = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			is_adult = yes
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor.faith != scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient = { is_courtier_of = scope:actor }
		scope:recipient = { is_ruler = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	cooldown_against_recipient = { years = 15 }

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		valid_demand_conversion_conditions_trigger = yes
	}

	ai_accept = {
		# Death Stare safety net
		ds_cowed_ai_accept_modifier = yes
		base = 0

		celestial_hierarchy_acceptance_modifier = {
			ACTOR = scope:actor
			RECIPIENT = scope:recipient
		}

		# Increase base chance
		modifier = {
			add = 50
			desc = EDUCATE_CHILD_ACTOR_IS_MY_LIEGE
		}
		religion_demand_conversion_default_modifier = yes
		religion_demand_conversion_christian_situation_modifier = yes
	}

	auto_accept = {
		OR = {
			custom_description = {
				text = ds_cowed_auto_accept_reason
				subject = scope:actor
				object = scope:recipient
				ds_cowed_auto_accept_trigger = yes
			}
			custom_description = {
				text = "spending_hook"
				subject = scope:actor
				object = scope:recipient
				scope:hook = yes
				scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { scope:recipient = { has_character_flag = ai_will_not_convert } }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 5

	on_accept = {
		demand_conversion_interaction_effect = yes
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:actor = {
				send_interface_message = {
					type = event_religious_good
					title = ask_for_conversion_courtier_interaction.tt
					left_icon = scope:recipient
					scope:recipient = {
						show_as_tooltip = { demand_conversion_interaction_effect = yes }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:hook = yes }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_usable_hook = scope:recipient
					}
					use_hook = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				save_scope_value_as = {
					name = forcibly_converted
					value = yes
				}
			}
		}

		# If we're a clan this interaction affects unity
		accept_faith_conversion_add_clan_unity_effect = yes

		# If character is converting to the state faith, we add influence
		state_faith_conversion_add_piety_effect = yes

		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_character_struggle = {
						involvement = involved
						has_struggle_phase_parameter = piety_from_converting_involved_rulers
						is_secondary_character_involvement_involved_trigger = {
							CHAR = scope:recipient
						}
					}
				}
				add_piety = medium_piety_gain
			}
		}

		conversion_tenet_acts_of_the_apostles_effect = yes

		# If you have the Mendicant Preaching personal tenet we give you SP
		conversion_tenet_mendicant_preachers_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		#Negative opinions
		scope:recipient = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:actor = {
						refusing_conversion_is_crime_trigger = {
							CHARACTER = scope:recipient
						}
					}
					scope:recipient = {
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:actor
					}
				}
				reverse_add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = illegal_resisted_conversion_opinion
					years = 10
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_opinion = {
					modifier = demanded_my_conversion_opinion
					target = scope:actor
					opinion = -10
				}
			}
		}
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_bad
				title = ask_for_conversion_decline_notification
				left_icon = scope:recipient
			}
		}

		# If we're a clan this interaction affects unity
		refuse_faith_conversion_add_clan_unity_effect = yes

		state_faith_refuse_conversion_add_piety_effect = yes
	}

	cost = {
		influence = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { scope:influence_send_option = yes }
				add = scope:actor.medium_influence_value
				desc = INFLUENCE_INTERACTION_ACCEPTANCE_SEND_OPTION
			}
		}
	}

	# Use hook
	send_option = {
		is_valid = {
			scope:actor = {
				has_usable_hook = scope:recipient
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor }
			}
		}
		flag = hook
		localization = SCHEME_HOOK
	}
	should_use_extra_icon = {
		scope:actor = { has_usable_hook = scope:recipient }
	}
	extra_icon = "gfx/interface/icons/character_interactions/hook_icon.dds"

	send_option = { # EP3 Influence
		is_shown = { # Actor must have a government that uses influence
			scope:actor = {
				government_has_flag = government_has_influence
			}
		}
		is_valid = {
			# Actor has enough influence
			scope:actor = { influence >= medium_influence_value }
			# Both characters are within the same top realm
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = not_same_realm_tt
				scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege
			}
		}
		flag = influence_send_option
		localization = TRADE_INFLUENCE_FOR_BETTER_AI_ACCEPTANCE
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no


	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100

		modifier = { # The AI will only use a Hook if they couldn't otherwise do this
			scope:hook = yes
			add = -1
		}

		modifier = { # The AI doesn't really want to convert Diasporic culture courtiers
			scope:recipient = {
				faith.religion = religion:judaism_religion
				culture = {
					has_cultural_tradition = tradition_diasporic
				}
			}
			factor = 0
		}

		modifier = { # Do not convert Righteous faith subjects, unless disturbingly zealous
			factor = 0
			scope:actor = {
				ai_zeal < 100
				rite = {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_fully_accepted_level
					}
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Astray faiths require specific circumstances to demand conversion of
			factor = 0
			scope:actor = {
				has_tolerant_faith_or_culture_trigger = yes
				ai_zeal < 100
				rite = {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_astray_level
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:actor
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Astray faiths require specific circumstances to demand conversion of
			factor = 0
			scope:actor = {
				rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_pluralism_fundamentalist }
				ai_zeal < -10
				rite = {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_astray_level
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:actor
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Astray faiths require specific circumstances to demand conversion of
			factor = 0
			scope:actor = {
				NOR = {
					rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_pluralism_fundamentalist }
					has_tolerant_faith_or_culture_trigger = yes
				}
				ai_zeal < 25
				rite = {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_astray_level
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:recipient = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:actor
				}
			}
		}

		modifier = { # Rulers with State Faith won't try to convert people with rites that are astray or better
			factor = 0
			scope:actor = {
				government_allows = state_faith
				primary_title.state_rite ?= {
					rite_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:recipient.rite
						value <= faith_astray_level
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
